observations: Tier1: 217 tests,195.34s; tier2:26 tests,12.16s; tier3:1907 tests,464.86s. Distinct workloads, no speedup claim.
One sandbox test attempt failed with oracle-cache access denied; approved unsandboxed offline rerun passed. No permission settings were changed.
Program Files write failed before any original rename; UAC-elevated trial passed and restored all originals.
Transaction rehearsed normal restoration and simulated interruption after each original rename.
Four-worker suite used; later resource observation recommended eight. No controlled comparison supports a new speed claim and no rerun is justified.

one_improvement.decision: Retain logs, compact receipts and verified rollback. Defer further tuning; do not rerun passed suites for benchmarking.
